observations: Photo 0 shows a single solar panel with a white aluminium frame, standing upright against an outdoor wall.
Cell grid is visible: multiple columns and rows of rectangular monocrystalline-style cells, consistent with a large multi-busbar panel.
A faint 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' watermark and camera metadata (Camon 30, 23mm, f/1.88, 1/146s, ISO50) overlay the image; these are seller/app additions, not panel markings.
No manufacturer label, spec sticker, serial number, or junction box is visible or legible.
No close-up of frame corners, backsheet, or cable/connector ends.
No multimeter, load test, or output reading shown anywhere.

claims.evidence: No spec sticker or label visible in photo 0; wattage cannot be read or confirmed from the panel face alone.
Photo 0 shows a dense cell grid consistent with a large-format panel, but individual cell count cannot be reliably counted due to angle and glare.
No brand name, logo, or label visible anywhere on the panel in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows visible surface smudging, slight haze on the glass, and frame wear consistent with a used panel.

risks.risk: Actual power output may be far below the claimed 600W, or panel may be non-functional.
risks.proof: Photo or short video of a multimeter/clamp meter connected to the panel in direct sunlight showing Voc/Isc or a load test.

risks.risk: Brand cannot be confirmed as a reputable Canadian manufacturer (e.g. Canadian Solar); could be an unbranded or rebadged panel.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear nameplate/sticker showing brand, model, and rated specs.

risks.risk: Hidden microcracks, hotspots, or delamination common in used panels, not visible in a glare-heavy front shot.
risks.proof: Multiple angled photos in even light, plus an electroluminescence (EL) test image if available.

risks.risk: Junction box, bypass diodes, or cable connectors could be damaged or missing, affecting usability.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear junction box and cable/MC4 connectors.

risks.risk: Frame or glass could have cracks or dents not visible from this single distant angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four corners and the glass surface.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rear nameplate/sticker showing brand, model number, and rated wattage.
Video/photo of a multimeter test (Voc, Isc) under sunlight to confirm functional output.
Close-up of the junction box and cable connectors.
Full front and rear photos in even lighting without glare, showing all four corners.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used solar panel of the type shown, but the seller's wattage, cell count, and brand claims are unverifiable from the single glare-heavy photo with no label or test shown, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proof.
